item.title: Haitian TPS holders barred from renewing drivers’ licenses in Florida, Ohio, New Jersey
item.description: In Florida, Ohio and New Jersey, Haitian TPS holders are reporting being turned away at their local motor vehicle offices. A federal judge’s stay on the termination of Haiti's TPS means work permits are safe, but not driver's licenses originally issued to match the employment authorization expiration dates.
